name: @elemental-ui/design-system
description: Avatar: The Last Airbender inspired elemental design system for Tailwind CSS v4

scripts.build: mkdir -p showcase/dist/fonts && cp src/fonts/*.ttf showcase/dist/fonts/ && npx @tailwindcss/cli -i showcase/main.css -o showcase/dist/output.css --minify
scripts.dev:showcase: mkdir -p showcase/dist/fonts && cp src/fonts/*.ttf showcase/dist/fonts/ && npx @tailwindcss/cli -i showcase/main.css -o showcase/dist/output.css --watch

author: Antigravity
